name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
summary: Predicted protein structures from EMBL-EBI's AlphaFold DB: model file URLs (mmCIF, bCIF, PDB), confidence estimates and AlphaMissense annotations, keyed on UniProt accessions.
notes: Every endpoint is keyed on a UniProt accession (e.g. Q5VSL9) or an AlphaFold model id; responses carry URLs to the model files, which are downloaded separately.

endpoints.name: Get predicted models for a protein
endpoints.summary: All AlphaFold models for a UniProt accession or model id, with model file URLs and quality estimates.

qualifier.description: A UniProt accession or an AlphaFold model id.

sequence_checksum.description: MD5 checksum of the UniProt sequence.

include_complexes.description: Also return complex models; false by default.

endpoints.name: Get complex models for a protein
endpoints.summary: All complex models that include a UniProt accession or model id.

qualifier.description: A UniProt accession or an AlphaFold model id.

endpoints.name: Get the structure summary for a UniProt entry
endpoints.summary: AlphaFold models covering a UniProt accession's residue range, in summary form.

endpoints.name: Find models by sequence
endpoints.summary: A summary of the AlphaFold models available for an amino-acid sequence or its MD5 checksum.

id.description: The sequence, or its MD5 checksum when type is md5.

type.description: What id is; sequence by default.

endpoints.name: Get AlphaMissense annotations
endpoints.summary: Annotations over a UniProt accession's residue range; MUTAGEN returns AlphaMissense variant-effect predictions.

type.description: Annotation type; MUTAGEN is the only one documented (AlphaMissense).
